Name: Pam Alcorollic (Rolling Pam) (CP)
Author: Molenfeuer
Description:
Pam Alco-roll-icThis mod is inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34250790]spacechase0[/url] glorious modification [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2755]Spenny[/url] which let Penny spin the whole time. For me, the idea of a spinning villager was so funny that I decide to let Pam roll a bit when she walks.
[b][size=5]
Install[/size][/b][list=1]
[*]Download the newest version of this mod from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/96969738?tab=user+files]NexusMods[/url] or the GitHub [url=https://github.com/Molenfeuer/PamAlcorollic/releases]release page[/url]
[*]Extract the ZIP-File and put the folder into the mods folder of SMAPI (mostly located under "C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods")
[/list][size=5][b]
Features[/b][/size][list]
[*]Let Pam roll when she walks
[*]Seasonal changing outfits (requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits[/url]﻿)
[/list][size=5][b]
Contribute[/b][/size]
If something doesn't work, or you miss a feature, feel free to open a new issue on the [url=https://github.com/Molenfeuer/PamAlcorollic/issues]GitHub Page of this mod[/url]. I prefer the GitHub Page but if you really don't want to use it feel free to use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9603?tab=bugs]Issue Page here on NexusMods[/url].
[size=5][b]
